Name: Playable Villagers
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a Content Patcher content pack for[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14365] Stardew Impact[/url] that enables every vanilla villager as a playable character (with no special skills or abilities).

See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14365]Stardew Impact[/url] page for info on using this mod in-game.

Also see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14366]Emily for Stardew Impact[/url] for a playable character with an elemental skill and burst.


﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
